# How to Trade FOMC Rate Decisions

The FOMC sets US interest rates at eight scheduled meetings a year, with the statement at 14:00 ET and the Chair’s press conference at 14:30 ET.

Updated 28 September 2026 10 min read

## Summary

The Federal Open Market Committee holds eight scheduled meetings a year. The statement is released at 14:00 ET and the Chair’s press conference starts at 14:30 ET; economic projections and the dot plot are published in March, June, September and December. The rate decision is usually largely priced beforehand, so the reaction tends to come from the statement wording, the dots and the press conference, measured against fed funds futures pricing.

Federal Open Market Committee: 12 voting members, chaired by the Fed Chair

# The Warsh era begins at the Federal Reserve

July 15, 2026

## Key takeaways 

Kevin Warsh, in his first meeting as Fed chair, signaled that the central bank would emphasize price stability.

The recent upward pressure on prices will prompt the central bank to consider a rate hike in the near term.

That rate hike could come as soon as September, depending on the direction of inflation before then.

After much speculation, executives and investors last month got their first glimpse of how Kevin Warsh would approach leading the Federal Reserve, as the central bank held rates steady and adopted a decidedly hawkish tone on inflation.

By holding its policy rate between 3.5% and 3.75% at the Federal Open Market Committee meeting on June 17, the Fed signaled that it would emphasize price stability over maximum employment.
